posts.title: Algospeak : Your language is dangerous and extremist, Adam Aleksic cries
posts.description: In Algospeak , Adam Aleksic insists that right-wing neologisms, which he cannot even define accurately, are dangerous and extreme. Aleksic’s book has one and only one purpose – to grease the wheels for the extirpation of supposed enemies of the régime
